parts.name: assessment-objective

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Emergency access procedure has not been tested. Procedures must be regularly tested to ensure operability.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Emergency access accounts have not been reviewed in %v days (maximum: 90 days).

controls.title: Automatic logoff is not enabled. Sessions must terminate after inactivity.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Automatic logoff is not enabled. Sessions must terminate after inactivity.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Automatic logoff timeout is %v minutes. Recommended maximum is 15 minutes for systems with ePHI access.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Screen lock is not enabled. Unattended workstations accessing ePHI must lock automatically.

controls.title: System '%v' stores ePHI but data-at-rest encryption is not enabled.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: System '%v' stores ePHI but data-at-rest encryption is not enabled.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: System '%v' uses deprecated encryption algorithm '%v'. Use AES-256 or equivalent.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No documented encryption key management policy. Key management procedures must be documented.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Encryption keys have not been rotated in %v days. Annual rotation is recommended.

controls.title: Role-based access control not implemented. Access to ePHI must be based on job function.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Role-based access control not implemented. Access to ePHI must be based on job function.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: User '%v' has ePHI access with no documented business justification.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: User '%v' ePHI access has not been reviewed in %v days (maximum: 90 days).

controls.title: User '%v' has full ePHI access. Minimum necessary access principle requires limiting access to only what is needed.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: User '%v' has full ePHI access. Minimum necessary access principle requires limiting access to only what is needed.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Audit logging is not enabled on ePHI system '%v'. All ePHI systems must record activity.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: ePHI system '%v' does not audit event type '%v'.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Audit logs do not capture user identity. Logs must identify who performed each action.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Audit logs do not include timestamps. All log entries must be timestamped.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Audit logs do not capture source IP address. Network source must be recorded for ePHI access.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Audit logs do not capture action type (read/write/delete). Action type must be recorded.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Audit log retention is %v days. HIPAA requires minimum 6 years (2190 days) for audit documentation.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Audit logs are not backed up offsite. Log integrity requires backup to prevent tampering or loss.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Audit logs are not tamper-evident. Logs must be protected from modification or deletion.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Audit logs are not centralized. Distributed logs increase the risk of incomplete collection and tampering.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Audit logs are reviewed every %v days. Logs for ePHI systems should be reviewed at least weekly.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No automated alerting on audit log anomalies. Suspicious ePHI access should trigger immediate alerts.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No alerts configured for unauthorized ePHI access attempts. Failed access attempts must be monitored.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No monitoring for after-hours ePHI access. Unusual access times are a key indicator of unauthorized activity.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: no ePHI systems in scope (input.phi_systems is empty) — cannot certify Audit Controls. Declare the ePHI systems to be evaluated.

controls.title: Multi-factor authentication is not enabled for ePHI access. MFA is required for all ePHI system access.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Multi-factor authentication is not enabled for ePHI access. MFA is required for all ePHI system access.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: MFA is not required for remote ePHI access. Remote access must always require MFA.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: MFA is not required for privileged accounts. All privileged ePHI system accounts must use MFA.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: SMS-only MFA is configured. SMS is susceptible to SIM swapping. Offer TOTP or hardware key as alternatives.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Minimum password length is %v characters. HIPAA guidance recommends minimum 12 characters for ePHI systems.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Password complexity is not required. Passwords for ePHI access must meet complexity requirements.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Password maximum age is %v days. Passwords for ePHI access should be changed at least every 90 days.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Password history enforces only %v previous passwords. Enforce at least 12 to prevent password reuse.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Account lockout occurs after %v failed attempts. Maximum 5 failed attempts recommended for ePHI systems.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Account lockout is not enabled. Accounts must lock after repeated failed authentication attempts.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: User '%v' is using a default password. Default passwords must be changed before ePHI system access.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: User '%v' has a non-expiring password and ePHI access. Password expiration must be enforced for all ePHI users.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Privileged account '%v' is not enrolled in MFA. All privileged accounts must use MFA.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Re-authentication is not required for sensitive ePHI operations (delete, export). Require re-auth for high-risk actions.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Unlimited concurrent sessions are permitted. Limit concurrent sessions for ePHI access to detect credential sharing.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Service account '%v' with ePHI access uses password authentication. Service accounts should use certificate-based authentication.

controls.title: System '%v' does not have integrity checking enabled for ePHI. File integrity monitoring is required.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: System '%v' does not have integrity checking enabled for ePHI. File integrity monitoring is required.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: System '%v' integrity checks run every %v hours. Daily or more frequent checks are required for ePHI.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No change management process for ePHI systems. Changes must be controlled to prevent unauthorized alteration.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Archived ePHI is not write-protected. Historical records must be protected from modification.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Regular backups of ePHI are not configured. Backups are essential for recovery from corruption or destruction.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: ePHI is backed up every %v hours. Daily backups are the recommended minimum.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: ePHI backups are not stored offsite or in cloud. Backups must be protected from site-level disasters.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: ePHI backup restoration has not been tested. Backups must be verified to ensure recoverability.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: ePHI backup restore test is %v days old. Test restoration at least quarterly.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No secure deletion policy for ePHI. Media containing ePHI must be securely destroyed when no longer needed.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Media containing ePHI is being reused without sanitization. Media must be sanitized before reuse.

controls.title: No cryptographic hashing or checksums used for ePHI. Hash-based integrity verification is required.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: No cryptographic hashing or checksums used for ePHI. Hash-based integrity verification is required.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Hash algorithm '%v' is cryptographically weak. Use SHA-256 or stronger for ePHI integrity verification.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: ePHI exports do not use digital signatures. Signatures provide non-repudiation and integrity assurance.

controls.title: System '%v' transmits ePHI without encryption. All ePHI in transit must be protected.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: System '%v' transmits ePHI without encryption. All ePHI in transit must be protected.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: System '%v' uses deprecated protocol '%v' for ePHI transmission. Use TLS 1.2 or higher.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Network carrying ePHI is not segmented. ePHI traffic should be isolated from general network traffic.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Remote ePHI access is permitted without VPN. VPN or equivalent encrypted tunnel is required.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: VPN protocol '%v' is insecure. Use IKEv2/IPsec, OpenVPN, or WireGuard.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: VPN split tunneling is enabled. ePHI traffic must route entirely through the encrypted VPN tunnel.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Data Loss Prevention (DLP) is not enabled on email. DLP prevents accidental unencrypted ePHI transmission.

controls.title: Minimum TLS version is %v. TLS 1.2 is the minimum acceptable; TLS 1.3 is recommended.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Minimum TLS version is %v. TLS 1.2 is the minimum acceptable; TLS 1.3 is recommended.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Weak cipher suite '%v' is enabled. Remove all weak ciphers from TLS configuration.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: TLS certificate expiry is not monitored. Expired certificates break encrypted ePHI transmission.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: TLS certificate expires in %v days. Renew immediately to prevent unencrypted ePHI exposure.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: APIs transmitting ePHI do not use mutual TLS (mTLS). mTLS provides stronger authentication for ePHI endpoints.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: ePHI is sent via email without encryption enforcement. Require S/MIME or PGP for all ePHI email.

controls.title: Message authentication (MAC/HMAC) is not enabled for ePHI transmission. Transmission integrity cannot be verified.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Message authentication (MAC/HMAC) is not enabled for ePHI transmission. Transmission integrity cannot be verified.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: API endpoint '%v' transmitting ePHI does not use request signing. Implement HMAC or digital signatures.
